author: steven5703
body:
It would be nice if the game selector in the lobby did not refresh (as in the servers move around depending on how many players the game has) while you had it open. Reason being is that (gonna use dtm01 and dtm02 as an example) if I wanted to join "DTM01", I would move my mouse over DTM01 and right as im about to click it, more players join DTM02 and DTM02 moves right where I was going to click, so I click DTM02 instead of DTM01. Hopefully that made sense

What it should be like:
The server selector won't refresh while it's open. It will only refresh if I close it and open it again, or go back one page (to the list with all the gamemodes) and then click the gamemode I want again.
